name: Water Management Pilot Providencia
comment: Juan 2026-11-02: RG-T4182 holds 4 pilots (Quito, San Salvador, Renca, Providencia). The HUB process evaluation lists 'Gestión Hídrica y Uso Eficiente del Agua' separately for Renca (Condominio Vista Hermosa) and Providencia (municipal building). The Water Consumption Reduction in Buildings entry becomes Renca; Providencia is split out and shares the documents that cover both communes.
